question: Ayush starts his journey from Chandigarh to Ludhiana with his car at a speed of 77 km/hr and returns at a speed of 63 km/hr. If the distance between Chandigarh and Ludhiana is 97 km, then what is the average speed (in km/hr) of Ayush during his whole journey?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When the distance covered is the same for two parts of a journey, the actual distance is not required.

Average Speed = 2xy ÷ (x + y)

⇒ Average Speed = (2 × 77 × 63) ÷ (77 + 63)

⇒ Average Speed = 9702 ÷ 140 = 69.3 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 69.3 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Forward Speed (x) = 77 km/hr

Return Speed (y) = 63 km/hr

Distance (D) = 97 km
